body.name: welfare-budgeted honest-width envelope
body.construction: \(W_{T,\delta}(\rho;\mathcal Q)=\inf_{\mathsf D\in\mathfrak D_T(\rho;\mathcal Q)}\inf_{I_T\in\mathfrak C_{T,\delta}(\mathsf D;\mathcal Q)}\sup_{P\in\mathcal Q}\mathbb E_{P,\mathsf D}|I_T(O_{1:T})|\), where the same \(P\)-independent Borel map \(I_T\) is used in every law, with value \(+\infty\) when \(\mathfrak D_T(\rho;\mathcal Q)=\varnothing\).
